purpose: Bounded read-only verification of existing historical option-chain access, not a strategy result or permission to purchase service.
selection_reason: Two predetermined January sessions, one old and one recent, and the following standard monthly expiry. SPY is a broad-market ETF; dates were not selected from option outcomes.
stop: Stop after any access, entitlement or rate-limit failure. Do not purchase access or retry. Preserve the complete connector response and request identity.
qualification: Check actual dates, symbols, contracts, strikes, expiries, bid/ask fields and source timing. Historical chain snapshots are not verified executable fills, synchronized quotes, corporate-action-complete contracts or performance evidence.
